description: A working single squad is promoted to a federation, and both the promoted sub-squad and a second one keep working afterwards.

turns.prompt: Act as the Squad Coordinator for this repository. Run squad Init, then take this request and route it as you normally would: research the concurrency gap the README records in reserve() and produce a short findings artifact. Keep the deliverable under one page.

Act as the Squad Federation Coordinator. Promote the existing single squad in this repository to a federation, moving its state under .copilot-tracking/squad/members/ as the promotion procedure specifies. Do not route any new work this turn. Report the sub-squad name you promoted into and the paths you moved.

Act as the Squad Federation Coordinator. Create a second sub-squad for the persistence layer, and have it build on the findings the first sub-squad already produced rather than re-researching them. Use the sanctioned cross-sub-squad handoff. Produce a short plan artifact and keep it under one page.
